title: A session that writes an allow rule to settings.local.json is asked whether it belongs in the shared settings.json
why: Owner asks whether sessions add permission allowances to local settings when they should be global.
source: Consultant 20:20 CST Nov 13, from the owner's chat 20:16; unmeasured, since cloud sessions' local files are not readable from there.
note: Filed 20:17 CST Nov 13. Owner 20:16 CST Nov 13 (relayed): sessions may add allowances locally that should be global. Unmeasured: how often it happens. Fix: when a session writes an allow rule to settings.local.json, a guard asks whether it belongs in the shared settings.json and routes it to a lane PR. A guard; the lane measures first (read settings.local.json files that are readable), then test-author red case, builder, reviewer. Needs a lane.
